overview: India's capital and the Taj Mahal, linked by fast trains. Delhi has great museums, monuments and food; Agra has the Taj and Agra Fort.
fit: Good learning trip for the 10-year-old; the 4-year-old will enjoy the Rail Museum, Science Centre and big lawns.
season: October–November and February–March are best (15–30°C). December–January can be foggy (train delays) and cold; check air quality, which is often poor in Nov–Jan. April–June is very hot.

gettingThere.detail: Gatimaan Express or Vande Bharat Delhi–Agra

gettingAround: Delhi Metro is excellent; app cabs for the rest.

todo.title: Taj Mahal at sunrise
todo.cost: ~₹1,300 per adult (foreigner rates don't apply); kids under 15 free

todo.title: Agra Fort
todo.why: Red sandstone fort with Taj views

todo.title: Akshardham
todo.why: Huge temple and evening water show

stay.why: Central or near the airport, on the metro

foodTips: Lots of vegetarian choice. Avoid street chaat for the kids.
save: Kids under 15 enter ASI monuments free
Use the metro instead of cabs
Do Agra as a day trip by train if you prefer one hotel
safety: Check AQI before going; carry N95 masks in winter
Use prepaid or app cabs only
Hold hands in crowds; agree a meeting point
health: Delhi belly: stick to busy, clean restaurants
kids: Go to the Taj at sunrise to beat heat and crowds
The Rail Museum toy train is a winner for the 4-year-old

days.plan: Fly to Delhi; India Gate in the evening
Rail Museum, Humayun's Tomb, Akshardham water show
Early train to Agra; Taj Mahal and Agra Fort; train back
Science Centre or PM Museum; fly home
